The '''YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighter''' was a bulky [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It became known as the '''Zygerrian slave ship''' due to its widespread use by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] such as [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] and [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassians]].

==History==
[[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]], a Zygerrian who allied himself with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Captain/Legends|captained]] a reddish-colored slave ship named the [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']]. Another grey-colored ship, the [[Delta-T-3/Legends|Delta-T-3]] was used to transport a captive [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] "Rex" and the [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] governor [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].
